summary: Validated the new Tokens economy end-to-end on both the shared backend and the web frontend. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering welcome 100, daily +25 and 429 cooldown, Store list/buy violet (-120)/400 on re-buy/402 insufficient/404 unknown, e-transfer (debit+credit+notification, self 400, unknown 404, overdraw 402), game level-1 first-win reward with wallet increase and zero on replay, super-admin grant 200 vs non-admin 403, premium cosmetic equip 403 unless owned (and 200 after buy), and the live WS flow charging the sender + emitting {type:'wallet',balance} and {type:'error',detail:'insufficient_tokens'} with the broadcaster credited. Web (hamburger-first UX at 390x844): hamburger-menu-trigger opens hamburger-menu-panel, menu-token-balance updates 100 -> 125 after menu-claim-daily, menu-wallet/menu-market link; /wallet renders wallet-page with wallet-balance, wallet-claim-daily, transfer-username/amount/note/submit, wallet-history, and a UI e-transfer debits 125 -> 115; /market shows market-balance-pill, store-frame-violet with store-frame-buy-violet. Mobile Expo web preview was blocked at auth by the known CORS limitation (allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is rejected by browsers; /api/auth/me CORS'd on social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com); the mobile wallet.tsx, HamburgerDrawer.tsx, home.tsx and LiveOverlay.tsx all contain the required testIDs (wallet-balance, wallet-claim-daily, transfer-*, store-frame-buy-*, header-menu-button, hamburger-drawer-panel, drawer-token-balance, drawer-claim-daily, drawer-wallet, live-token-balance, live-gift-*).

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is rejected by browsers for credentialed cross-origin requests. This blocks Expo web preview (different host) from calling the API. Set allow_origins to explicit list (preview + expo preview + prod) or disable credentials.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by backend CORS (wildcard + credentials). Cannot complete mobile e2e via Expo web preview until CORS is fixed. Native build would be unaffected.

parity_issues.issue: Could not reach authenticated screens through Expo web preview due to backend CORS limitation (pre-existing env issue, not Tokens-economy regression). Web parity confirmed via code review of testIDs.

action_items: Fix backend CORS: replace allow_origins=['*']+allow_credentials=True with explicit origins list including https://social-hub-dev-4.preview.emergentagent.com, https://social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com and production hosts. Needed to unblock mobile Expo web preview auth.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet_core.spend() is atomic via conditional $gte update — good; prevents overdraw races.
Game reward only on first win is enforced via prev.get('completed') before updating the progress doc — correct order.
Transfer notifies the recipient inside a try/except that swallows errors silently — fine for best-effort UX but consider logging the exception.
live.py gift path correctly short-circuits on insufficient balance and only credits the broadcaster when owner != sender and cost > 0 — good self-gift guard.
CORS: allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is invalid per the spec and breaks cross-origin credentialed requests (observed on mobile preview).

success_rate.frontend: web 100% of validated flows; mobile not e2e-validatable in this env (CORS)

Mobile Expo web preview auth is blocked by CORS wildcard+credentials config; validate mobile via native build or after CORS fix. All required testIDs confirmed present in mobile code (wallet.tsx, HamburgerDrawer.tsx, home.tsx, LiveOverlay.tsx).
rca of the issue: CORS error on Expo web preview: FastAPI CORSMiddleware is configured with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True. Per the Fetch spec, browsers reject Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on credentialed requests, so /api/auth/me from https://social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com fails. Fix: enumerate explicit origins (preview, expo preview, production) and keep allow_credentials=True.
